name: Shy_2
short_caption: The robot bashfully brings its hands together near its stomach while tilting its head slightly, conveying shyness.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and slowly brings both hands inward, crossing them slightly in front of its lower torso. At the same time, it tilts its head to the right and glances slightly downward, holding this bashful posture for several seconds. Finally, it smoothly returns its hands to its sides and brings its head back to a level, forward-facing neutral position.
